why: Applied last so that every earlier operation can name the place as it was when the finding was made; the applier follows these renames on lookup. Kerala is NOT renamed: the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026 is in force, but government sites, LGD and every existing address still use 'Kerala', so the owner keeps 'Kerala' canonical with 'Keralam' as an alias (decision of 18 Nov 2026).

state portal and https://ribhoi.gov.in/ write 'Ri Bhoi'

Reverts a rename that was applied on 18 Nov 2026 and reached the database before the owner decided Kerala stays canonical. A no-op on a fresh build (there is no Keralam to rename); its remap rule carries listings and projects that were already moved to 'Keralam' back to 'Kerala'.
